summary: Empties the rows a predicate selects, leaving the rows in place.
description: The contents go and the rows stay, so positions do not shift and anything referring to a row by its number keeps pointing at the same place. `deleteRowsByConditional` is the one that removes them.
The sheet is read once and the clearing is grouped into consecutive blocks, so a scattered selection still costs few calls to the service.

params.predicate: Receives the row's cells, its one-based position and — when `headerRow` is set — the row keyed by the column names. Return `true` for the rows to act on.
params.options: `headerRow` names the row holding the column names. Setting it keys each row by those names and keeps the header row itself out of the candidates.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is not a sheet.
throws.IllegalArgumentException: the predicate is not a function, or the header position is not a positive integer.
